Definition: from G4703; sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field:--corn(-field).
BiblicalUsage: The sown field is where the disciples walked on the Sabbath, plucking the ears of corn and eating, rubbing them in their hands. All three Gospels tell it, and the Pharisees' charge follows in each.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cornfield is the test of the Sabbath: hunger met the law, and the Lord of the Sabbath fed His disciples.
